subject: Launch commissioning: ops-bridge certification & observability checklist
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@acme-ops.com>, SRE Team <sre@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-14T08:12:00Z
Subject: Launch commissioning: ops-bridge certification & observability checklist

Hi all,

Final checklist for today's commissioning window attached (ops-bridge-checklist-v3.pdf). Key asks before greenlight:
- ACLs on customer VPC verified (IP ranges + port whitelist)
- KV cache priming completed for the lower 90th percentile traffic pattern (see kv-warmup-script.sh)
- Observability dashboards created and sampling validated: latency P50/P95, token cost per request, model fallback counters
- Post-deploy smoke run (10 min) with canary traffic to validate KV hit-rate and end-to-end SLOs

Sanjay, can Acme SRE confirm the VPN tunnel health and NAT mapping will be stable during the window? If we see NAT remap, we will trigger the fallback lane.

Irene: please lead the ops-bridge and own the command log. Marissa: you'll monitor model routing and fallback alerts. Mateo: run the KV warmup and share evidence (logs/screenshots).

I'll open the ops-bridge at T-10 and coordinate the OOB channel.

Thanks,

Jonas
VP, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Attachments: ops-bridge-checklist-v3.pdf, kv-warmup-script.sh (stub)
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@acme-ops.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: SRE Team <sre@acme-corp.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-14T09:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Launch commissioning: ops-bridge certification & observability checklist

Jonas,

Confirming VPN tunnel is green (IKEv2 SA up) and NAT mappings are sticky for the scheduled window. We ran a quick throughput ramp earlier and didn't see NAT churn. I'll have our network engineer on the bridge at T-15 with the ipsec logs.

One ask: can you add an explicit health-check endpoint on the ingress that returns KV priming status (200/204 with JSON flag)? That will make our automation gate faster.

Sanjay
SRE Manager, Acme Corporation

Attachment: obs-sample-dashboard.png
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@acme-ops.com>
Date: 2027-04-14T11:22:00Z
Subject: RE: Launch commissioning: ops-bridge certification & observability checklist

All,

I've updated the ops-bridge runbook with a short decision tree for the first 30 minutes (Confluence link in related_links). Quick summary of who does what:
- Bridge lead (me): overall go/no-go after canary run; maintain command log
- Model routing (Marissa): confirm model variant, token cost delta, and fallback counter < 5%
- KV (Mateo): run kv-warmup-script.sh, post S3 evidence of warmup complete and KV hit-rate >= 85%
- Net (Sanjay): monitor tunnel SA and BGP routes; call for failover if route flapping > 2 occurrences in 5 min

I added a short check to the health-check endpoint idea and pushed a tiny lambda that returns kv_status and kv_hit_rate for automation to poll. I'm putting it on the bridge channel once it's in place.

Irene
Principal PM, Infrastructure

Date: 2027-04-14T13:01:00Z
Subject: RE: Launch commissioning: ops-bridge certification & observability checklist

Irene / Team,

KV warmup finished at 12:45Z. Evidence uploaded: s3://acme-priming/evidence/kv-warmup-20270414.log (link via Confluence). Summary:
- Primed ~120k keys (replicated across local shards)
- Steady-state hit rate observed: 88% after priming script completed
- CPU on nodes remained < 60% during burn-in; no OOM events

I ran a mini smoke: 500 concurrent small requests routed through the canary. Observed latency P50=32ms, P95=210ms, model fallback events=1 (at 12:38, traced to a transient model load spike). Fallback counter currently at 0 after the model reload.

I'll be on the ops-bridge to paste logs; kv-warmup-script.sh is the same script referenced in the checklist.

Mateo
Senior Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: kv-warmup-script.sh (stub)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@acme-ops.com>, Lauren Morris <lauren.morris@vendor-monitor.com>
Date: 2027-04-14T15:47:00Z
Subject: RE: Launch commissioning: ops-bridge certification & observability checklist

Bridge closed: greenlight issued at 15:40Z. Quick post-run notes and one action:

What passed:
- KV hit-rate steady at ~89% over the 20-minute validation window
- Model routing stable; token cost delta within expected tolerance (+3.2%)
- Observability alerts behaved as expected (no noisy false positives)
- VPN/NAT stable, no tunnel resets observed

Action: Sanjay asked for automated daily KV warmup in the first 30 minutes of business-day traffic for first-week after launch. Sanjay, please confirm desired schedule (cron) and retention for evidence logs.

I'll archive the ops-bridge command log to Confluence and attach the bridge closure snapshot (obs-sample-dashboard.png). Thanks everyone for fast coordination.

-Marissa
Director, Operations
Redwood Inference
